question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Consensus for Apple Q4 FY26 (Sept quarter) GAAP EPS is $1.98-1.99 on ~$113B revenue. Guidance (rev +9-11%, GM 47-48% incl. ~1pt tariff-refund benefit, opex $19.1-19.4B) with ~18% tax and ~14.65B diluted shares yields ~$1.96-2.00 bottom-up. Apple has beaten consensus 8 straight quarters, typically by 2-5% excluding unmodeled one-offs (Q3 FY26 $2.02 vs 1.89 included $0.11 tariff refunds), so median ~$2.04. Small tail for a one-off tax/legal charge (precedent: Q4 FY24 EU state-aid charge, EPS $0.97). No matching human market on the EPS level found (Polymarket runs beat/miss contracts only).

calls.reconciliation: Main factual dispute: opex assumption. Run 2 used ~$17.3B (extrapolated from FY25), but Run 1's dossier cites guidance of $19.1-19.4B and Run 3 confirms Q3 FY26 actual opex was $19.1B; I accept the guidance, which drops Run 2's bottom-up from ~$2.07 to ~$1.96-2.00, in line with consensus. Tax rate (16-18%) is unsettled and adds ~$0.02 uncertainty. Beat magnitude is judgment: historical 3-5% ex one-offs -> ~$2.04-2.06; I take $2.04 since guidance already embeds the tariff refund. Carried forward Run 3's dispersion (~0.17) and the 1% sub-$1 tail from Run 1's one-off charge precedent. No web access on this run.
